settings.label: How We Work
settings.sub: Design, development and construction, carried by one team from site to handover.

settings.text: A residence is at its best when the people who design it are the people who build it. At Sabdia they are: architecture, interiors, development and construction sit within the one studio, to one standard.
The same team makes every decision, from the first sketch to handover day. Nothing is handed off, and nothing is lost between disciplines.

settings.label: Design
settings.title: Architecture & Design
settings.paragraphs:
Every residence is drawn in-house, and every drawing begins with the site: its light, its fall, its street and the way a family will live on it.
Proportion, material and light are resolved together on paper, so the home arrives on site already decided.
settings.bullets:
Architectural concept and schematic design
Design development and documentation
Planning approvals and DA management
Landscape architecture
Material and finishes specification
3D visualisation and walkthroughs

settings.label: Development
settings.title: Development Management
settings.paragraphs:
Development management is everything between the land and the keys: planning, engineering, approvals, program and delivery.
All of it sits with the same team that designs and builds, so fewer hand-offs mean a tighter program and a cleaner result.
settings.bullets:
Site acquisition analysis and due diligence
Feasibility modelling and investment structuring
Town planning strategy and DA management
Engineering and civil coordination
Sales and marketing strategy
Project reporting and stakeholder management

settings.label: Interiors
settings.title: Interior Architecture
settings.paragraphs:
Interior architecture runs alongside the architecture from the first line, so the inside of a residence is planned with the same care as its form.
Kitchens, bathrooms, joinery and lighting are designed as one composition, and the palette carries from room to room without a change of language.
settings.bullets:
Interior concept and spatial design
Custom joinery design and specification
Material, finish, and hardware selection
Lighting design and coordination
FF&E procurement and styling
Kitchen and bathroom design

settings.label: Construction
settings.title: Construction
settings.paragraphs:
Sabdia's own team builds every residence, with trades who have worked alongside the studio for years and hold the same standard.
Natural stone, warm timber and honest materials, laid and finished by hand and checked at every stage. Right at handover, and right in twenty years.
settings.bullets:
Full residential construction management
Material sourcing and procurement
Trade coordination
Quality assurance and defect management
Owner reporting and site access
Post-completion care and warranty

settings.title: Design
settings.description: Every residence begins with its site, its street and the people who will live there.

settings.title: Develop
settings.description: Approvals, planning and engineering, resolved in-house so each decision stays with the team that made it.

settings.title: Construct
settings.description: Built by our own team, to the drawings and the materials specified, with a check at every stage.

settings.title: Deliver
settings.description: Handover is not the end of the relationship. The team stays close to the home and to its owners.
